description: Get the account's API spend controls and the limits actually enforced, in cents. `spendLimit` caps everything bought over the API in a calendar month (registrations, renewals, transfers, closeouts, paid hosting): `limit`, `source` (`account` = set by the account holder, `default` = none set so $100 applies, `none` = no cap), `spent` and `remaining`. `topupLimit` caps credit added over the API (card, auto top-up, MPP, USDC together): `limit`, `source`, `added`. `settings` is what the account holder configured. Check `remaining` before an expensive operation: a purchase over it fails with MONTHLY_SPEND_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, and only the account holder can raise the limit, on the website.
name: get_api_settings
title: Get API Settings
